purpose: The one list of patches both flattening engines are tested on. scripts/test_flatten_accuracy.mjs and scripts/test_flatten_parity.mjs (which runs scripts/flatten.py) read this file, so the two sides cannot drift on which patch they measured.

cases.note: Developable: unrolls to a rectangle with zero distortion. The flattening must reproduce every edge length exactly.
Developable: unrolls to an annular sector. Same zero-distortion expectation, on a surface whose flat outline is curved.
Roughly one cup. Not developable: total Gaussian curvature ~130 deg, so the seam error here is a property of the body, recorded so the reason panels are split stays visible.
A closed loop on the skin, the shape the pen tool produces, filled by flood-fill and held to length by chord constraints. Exercises patch extraction rather than a face set handed in.
The one-cup loop cut through the apex into two panels that share the seam. Solved together so the shared chords agree in length in both pieces; scripts/test_seam_closure.mjs gates the mismatch.
